shots.scene: 欣欣站在打开的配电箱旁，指着一个带小按钮的空白模块
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an open lab distribution box and points at a blank breaker module with a small test button.
shots.narration: 这一课认识漏电保护器。
overlay: 漏电保护器：两种型式与正确使用

shots.scene: 原理、区别、使用三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a gear, a pair of balance scales and a hand pressing a button. No people.
shots.narration: 怎么工作、有何区别、怎样用好。

shots.scene: 实验室突然断电，阿杰站在黑下来的实验台旁
shots.prompt_en: The lights on a lab bench go dark; the young male student looks around in surprise.
shots.narration: 实验室突然断电，阿杰一头雾水。

shots.scene: 阿杰伸手要把配电箱里跳下的开关推上去
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches into the distribution box toward a breaker lever that has flipped down.
shots.narration: 他想直接把跳下的开关推上去。

shots.scene: 老周按住他的手摇头
shots.prompt_en: The older man gently stops the young male student's hand and shakes his head.
shots.narration: 老周拦住他：先弄清它为什么跳。

shots.scene: 欣欣在配电箱前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the distribution box and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 跳闸，往往是在提醒你有漏电。

shots.scene: 两个外观相似的空白模块并排，中间有问号
shots.prompt_en: Two similar blank breaker modules side by side with a big question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 漏电保护有两个名字，常被弄混。

shots.scene: 小研拿着两张空白卡片对比
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds two blank cards and compares them thoughtfully.
shots.narration: 先把它们的区别弄清楚。

shots.scene: 第一个模块下方有接地符号和漏电小箭头
shots.prompt_en: A blank breaker module with a ground symbol and a small leaking arrow beneath it. No people.
shots.narration: 一个叫接地漏电断路器。

shots.scene: 第二个模块下方有两个电流箭头和差值符号
shots.prompt_en: A blank breaker module with two opposite current arrows and a small difference symbol beneath it. No people.
shots.narration: 一个叫剩余电流断路器。

shots.scene: 旧模块被放进回收箱，新模块装上导轨
shots.prompt_en: An old style blank breaker module goes into a recycling bin while a new blank module clicks onto a mounting rail. No people.
shots.narration: 后者是新一代，基本取代了前者。

shots.scene: 简化示意：进线两根、出线两根，中间一个感测块
shots.prompt_en: A simple diagram: two incoming wires at the top, two outgoing wires at the bottom, a blue sensing block on the side. No people.
shots.narration: 先看老式的电压型。

shots.scene: 感测块下方一根绿黄线连到设备金属外壳和接地
shots.prompt_en: From the sensing block a green and yellow wire runs to the metal case of an instrument and down to a ground symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 它的感测块接着设备外壳的接地线。

shots.scene: 相线碰到设备金属外壳，闪出火花
shots.prompt_en: In the diagram, a live wire touches the inside of the metal instrument case with a small spark. No people.
shots.narration: 如果相线碰到了金属外壳，

shots.scene: 电流沿接地线流过感测块，感测块发亮
shots.prompt_en: Glowing dots flow from the case down the ground wire through the sensing block, which lights up. No people.
shots.narration: 电流沿接地线流过感测线圈，

shots.scene: 感测块推动开关断开，设备灯灭
shots.prompt_en: The sensing block pushes the switch contacts open and the instrument goes dark, a green check appears. No people.
shots.narration: 产生电压，推动开关断开电源。

shots.scene: 一个圆环，相线和中性线一起从中间穿过
shots.prompt_en: A ring shaped core with a red wire and a black wire passing together through its center. No people.
shots.narration: 新型的电流型，靠一个零序互感器。

shots.section_title: 电流型：正常时进出相等
shots.scene: 红线上向右的箭头，黑线上向左的箭头，长度相等
shots.prompt_en: On the red wire an arrow points toward the load, on the black wire an equal arrow points back. No people.
shots.narration: 它时刻比较流出和流回的电流。
overlay: 电流型：正常时进出相等

shots.section_title: 电流型：正常时进出相等
shots.scene: 天平两端相等，平衡
shots.prompt_en: A balance scale with equal weights on both sides, perfectly level, next to the ring core. No people.
shots.narration: 正常时一样多，互感器里相互抵消。

shots.section_title: 电流型：正常时进出相等
shots.scene: 仪器正常工作，开关保持闭合
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument running normally connected through the breaker module, which stays on. No people.
shots.narration: 合起来为零，它就不动作。

shots.section_title: 电流型：漏电时不再相等
shots.scene: 一只手形图标碰到红线，一股小箭头经身体流向地面
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a hand touching the red wire, with a small arrow running through a body pictogram down to the ground. No people.
shots.narration: 有人碰到相线，或者设备漏电，
overlay: 电流型：漏电时不再相等

shots.section_title: 电流型：漏电时不再相等
shots.scene: 红线箭头变长，黑线箭头变短
shots.prompt_en: The arrow on the red wire is longer than the arrow on the black wire returning, highlighted difference. No people.
shots.narration: 有一部分电流从大地溜走了。

shots.section_title: 电流型：漏电时不再相等
shots.scene: 天平向一侧倾斜
shots.prompt_en: The balance scale tips to one side next to the ring core. No people.
shots.narration: 流出和流回就不再相等。

shots.section_title: 电流型：检出差值就跳闸
shots.scene: 圆环发亮，感测线圈发出信号
shots.prompt_en: The ring core glows and a small sensing coil around it sends a signal spark. No people.
shots.narration: 互感器马上检测到这个差值，
overlay: 电流型：检出差值就跳闸

shots.section_title: 电流型：检出差值就跳闸
shots.scene: 信号传到继电器，开关拨下
shots.prompt_en: The signal travels to a small relay coil, which flips the breaker lever down to off. No people.
shots.narration: 推动脱扣线圈，开关立即跳闸。

shots.section_title: 电流型：检出差值就跳闸
shots.scene: 手形图标旁出现盾牌
shots.prompt_en: The hand pictogram near the wire is now covered by a protective shield, power off icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电源切断，人就得到保护。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在左右两栏的空白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank board divided into left and right columns.
shots.narration: 把两者的区别总结一下。

shots.scene: 第二个模块旁又贴了一张空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The second blank breaker module gets an extra blank name tag attached to it. No people.
shots.narration: 后者也叫剩余电流装置。

shots.section_title: 区别二：电压型与电流型
shots.scene: 左栏电压表图标，右栏电流表图标
shots.prompt_en: On the left a voltmeter icon, on the right an ammeter icon, separated by a line. No people.
shots.narration: 老式的靠电压动作，
overlay: 区别二：电压型与电流型

shots.section_title: 区别二：电压型与电流型
shots.scene: 右栏电流表指针摆动
shots.prompt_en: The ammeter icon needle swings on the right side. No people.
shots.narration: 新型的靠电流差动作。

shots.scene: 左栏接地线断开，模块打问号
shots.prompt_en: On the left, the ground wire of the old module is broken, and the module shows a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 电压型离不开良好的接地线，

shots.scene: 左栏接地线断开，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: The broken ground wire on the left is crossed out with a red X, the module stays dark. No people.
shots.narration: 接地线一坏，它就失灵。

shots.scene: 右栏模块只比较两根线，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: On the right, the new module compares only the two wires through its ring, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 电流型检测时，不靠自身接地线。

shots.scene: 左栏漏电绕过接地线，从别处流走，模块未动作
shots.prompt_en: On the left, leakage current flows to ground through another path, bypassing the ground wire, the old module stays on. No people.
shots.narration: 电压型：漏电不走它的地线，就不跳。

shots.scene: 右栏漏电经人体流向大地，模块跳闸
shots.prompt_en: On the right, leakage current flows through a body pictogram to the ground and the new module trips off. No people.
shots.narration: 电流型：漏电从哪里走，都能发现。

shots.scene: 老式模块挂上淘汰标签
shots.prompt_en: The old style blank module gets a gray outdated tag and fades out. No people.
shots.narration: 老式电压型已经淘汰。

shots.scene: 新模块上贴着两个名字的空白标签
shots.prompt_en: One new blank breaker module with two blank name tags attached to it. No people.
shots.narration: 现在叫它什么，大多都是电流型。

shots.scene: 欣欣点头指着新模块
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot nods and points at the new breaker module.
shots.narration: 国内统称剩余电流动作保护器。

shots.scene: 小研按下配电箱里漏电保护器的试验按钮
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student presses the small test button on the breaker module in the distribution box.
shots.narration: 保护器上有个试验按钮。

shots.scene: 按钮按下，开关应声跳下，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: The test button is pressed and the breaker lever drops to off, a green check appears. No people.
shots.narration: 一按就跳，说明它还灵。

shots.scene: 日历图标和空白记录表
shots.prompt_en: A calendar icon next to a blank inspection record sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 按规定定期试验，并做好记录。

shots.scene: 按下按钮开关不动，打红叉，旁边报修电话
shots.prompt_en: The test button is pressed but the lever does not move, red X, a telephone icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 按了不跳，立即停用并报修。

shots.scene: 阿杰站在跳闸的配电箱前，手背在身后
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands in front of the distribution box with a tripped breaker, hands behind his back.
shots.narration: 跳闸了，别急着合上。

shots.scene: 反复推开关、用导线短接、拆掉保护器三个图标，都打叉
shots.prompt_en: Three icons each crossed out with a red X: a hand pushing a lever repeatedly, a wire jumper bypassing a module, and a module being removed. No people.
shots.narration: 不能反复强合，更不能短接拆除。

shots.scene: 拔掉台面上各仪器插头的图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of plugs being unplugged one by one from a bench power strip. No people.
shots.narration: 先拔下刚接上的设备，看看是谁漏电。

shots.scene: 老李拿着工具箱检查配电箱
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer with a toolbox inspects the distribution box while the older man watches.
shots.narration: 查不清，就报告负责人，请电工处理。

shots.section_title: 漏电保护器不是万能的
shots.scene: 欣欣举着盾牌图标，盾牌上有个缺口
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a shield icon that has a small gap in it.
shots.narration: 漏电保护器不是万能的。
overlay: 漏电保护器不是万能的

shots.section_title: 漏电保护器不是万能的
shots.scene: 双手同时碰两根线的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two hands touching the live wire and the neutral wire at the same time, with a red warning triangle. No people.
shots.narration: 人同时碰到两根线，它可能不跳。

shots.section_title: 漏电保护器不是万能的
shots.scene: 接地、绝缘、保护器三个图标叠在一起
shots.prompt_en: Three stacked icons: a ground symbol, an insulated cable and a breaker module, forming layers. No people.
shots.narration: 它代替不了接地和绝缘。

shots.section_title: 漏电保护器不是万能的
shots.scene: 仪器三孔插头插入三孔插座，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A lab instrument three-pin plug inserted into a three-pin socket with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 金属外壳设备照样要可靠接地。

shots.section_title: 哪些地方要有漏电保护
shots.scene: 实验室水槽旁的插座
shots.prompt_en: A wall socket near a lab sink with a splash guard. No people.
shots.narration: 潮湿的地方最需要漏电保护。
overlay: 哪些地方要有漏电保护

shots.section_title: 哪些地方要有漏电保护
shots.scene: 水浴锅、移动电动工具、插座回路三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a water bath, a handheld power drill and a row of wall sockets, each with a small shield. No people.
shots.narration: 用水设备、手持电动工具、插座回路，

shots.section_title: 哪些地方要有漏电保护
shots.scene: 空白的规范手册图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank regulation booklet icon with a check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 具体按现行标准和学校规定配置。

shots.section_title: 选型安装交给持证电工
shots.scene: 老李穿绝缘鞋戴绝缘手套，手持空白操作证
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears insulating gloves and boots and holds up a blank work permit card.
shots.narration: 安装和更换，交给持证电工。
overlay: 选型安装交给持证电工

shots.section_title: 选型安装交给持证电工
shots.scene: 带合格认证图标的新模块
shots.prompt_en: A new blank breaker module with a certification mark icon and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 选用合格产品，规格要和线路匹配。

shots.section_title: 选型安装交给持证电工
shots.scene: 学生自己拆配电箱的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a student hand opening a distribution box panel with a screwdriver, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 学生不得自行拆装配电箱。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现两个模块图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two floating blank breaker module icons.
shots.narration: 电压型靠地线，电流型比进出。

shots.scene: 天平倾斜，开关跳下
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tipped balance scale and a breaker lever dropping to off. No people.
shots.narration: 进出不等就跳闸，切断漏电。

shots.scene: 手指按试验按钮和日历图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a finger pressing a test button and a calendar. No people.
shots.narration: 定期按试验按钮，不灵就报修。

shots.scene: 跳闸开关、放大镜、电工图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a tripped breaker, a magnifying glass and a facility engineer's toolbox. No people.
shots.narration: 跳闸先查原因，别强合别短接。

shots.scene: 接地、绝缘、保护器三层盾牌
shots.prompt_en: Three layered shields with a ground symbol, an insulated cable and a breaker module. No people.
shots.narration: 接地、绝缘、漏保，一个都不能少。

shots.scene: 欣欣在关好门的配电箱旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera beside a closed distribution box.
shots.narration: 用好漏电保护，安全用电，下次见！
